title: Two problems on booksize and triangular edges in Nosal graphs
summary: A graph $G$ with $m$ edges is said to be a Nosal graph if $ρ(G)>\sqrt{m}$. For a graph $G$, we write $bk(G)$ for its maximum book size and $τ(G)$ for the number of edges contained in triangles. Li, Liu and Zhang [J. Combin. Theory Ser. B 179 (2026) 219--249] proved that every $m$-edge Nosal graph satisfies $bk(G)> \frac{1}{24}\sqrt{m}$ and $τ(G) > \frac{1}{12}\sqrt{m}$. Recently, two results on the booksize constant are proved: $\frac{1}{9}$ by Zhai, Li and Lou [arXiv:2601.10163v2], and $\frac{1}{4}$ by Chen, Li and Tang [arXiv:2607.16746v1].
